title: Russia CDN SNI whitelist scanner input

domains.title: SNI domains to scan
domains.description: SNI domains for TLS 1.3 + ALPN h2 + HTTPS probing, e.g. ["gosuslugi.ru", "mos.ru"].

includeDemoSample.title: Include the free demo sample of 25 SNI domains
includeDemoSample.description: Adds the free 25-domain demo of the 1,384-domain verified white-list base to the dataset.

includeOffer.title: Include the Pro offer record
includeOffer.description: Adds one summary record with the full-base purchase link for the SNI White-List Pro (TW1-SNI), the RUB price and the Plati.Market card.

concurrency.title: Parallel probe sockets
concurrency.description: How many DNS+TLS+HTTPS probes to run at once. Keep it at 12 or lower: 40 parallel sockets on a laptop behind a VPN trip both the local resolver and the remote rate-limiters.

minTls13.title: Minimum TLS 1.3 success rate
minTls13.description: Optional filter: keep only demo domains verified with TLS 1.3 in this run. 0 keeps everything.

minAlpnH2.title: Minimum ALPN h2 success rate
minAlpnH2.description: Optional filter: keep only demo domains verified with ALPN h2 in this run. 0 keeps everything.
